articles.title: College football's traditions are for sale. Florida-Georgia shows the multi-million-dollar price tag
articles.summary: As Florida-Georgia temporarily leaves Jacksonville for Atlanta and Tampa, the rivalry offers a glimpse into a future where even the most sacred games could b...
articles.body:
College football in the 2020s is a never-ending war between commerce and tradition, between a deep desire to preserve universities' distinctive identities and an even deeper desire to make money off those distinctive identities. One of the war's most notable battles is unfolding on the shores of the Atlantic Ocean in Jacksonville, Florida, where two of the SEC's rivals meet every year in a celebrated, anticipated, cherished battle. (Well, not every year, but we'll get to that.)

Florida-Georgia — or Georgia-Florida, depending on whether you're wearing red or blue to the game — is one of only three standing rivalry games played at a neutral site every year. (Texas-Oklahoma and Army-Navy are the others.) It's achieved legendary status for both institutions; a pilgrimage to Jacksonville is a must for every Dawg and Gator.

"It's one of the few events where twice as many people come to experience the game than actually go into the game," says Michael Corrigan, president and CEO of Visit Jacksonville. "The stadium holds some 80,000 people. Well, there's 150,000 people that are tailgating or participating some way in that particular weekend. … It's a three-and-a-half to four-hour commercial about Jacksonville, Florida on national TV."

"Jacksonville being a border town, there's just a lot of history and tradition," Florida athletic director Scott Stricklin told Yahoo Sports. "It just holds a unique place in college football lore, and it's important for our school to maintain that part of the rivalry."

It's a fantastic tradition, yes, but it's also immensely lucrative, and as we've seen everywhere across the college football landscape, tradition doesn't stand a chance against money. And what happens next in the Georgia-Florida-Jacksonville equation — which now includes Atlanta and Tampa for the next two years — could herald changes ahead for other major programs across the country.

The World's Largest Outdoor Branding Opportunity

Corporate and brand-minded interests have dubbed this year's Florida-Georgia game the "Invesco QQQ Atlanta Gridiron Classic," but everyone involved knows it by its traditional name: the World's Largest Outdoor Cocktail Party. When you're a student, you hang wherever you can find a beer and a bed; Frat Beach in nearby St. Simons Island is a longstanding Georgia tradition. When you're an alum with a bit more disposable income, you rent a Duval County Airbnb and whip up themed cocktails. And everyone, young and old, descends on Jacksonville's EverBank Stadium, dividing neatly into "Georgia" and "Florida" quadrants.

Well, except this year and next. Because EverBank is undergoing massive renovations, the party has moved to Atlanta this weekend and Tampa next year. The game will again take place in NFL stadiums — Mercedes-Benz in Atlanta, Raymond James in Tampa — before returning to Jacksonville in 2028 on a four-year contract .

The improvements to EverBank are both substantial and necessary for Jacksonville to keep pace with the expectations and demands of the NFL and other major entertainment entities. The $1.4 billion-plus renovation will include the installation of a canopy over the stadium, along with other fan-friendly improvements like widened concourses, in-stadium gathering spots and technology upgrades.

Jacksonville factored the Georgia-Florida game into its design and decision-making process; the stadium will feature tranches of permanent seats that can be deployed to increase the stadium's capacity by many thousands of fans, from 63,000 up to 70,000. Georgia and Florida are even featured in renderings of the stadium's future appearance.

"When they come back in '28, when Florida and Georgia walk in, the fans are going to be blown away at all the pageantry that we've had for all these years, plus the best stadium in the state of Florida for sure," Corrigan says. "It's going to be a great experience for those fans."

But these developments will take time. This year, the Jaguars are playing their home games before a significantly reduced capacity, which is part of the reason why several Jacksonville "home" games are in Europe. (If the Jaguars make the playoffs, they'll be playing in front of some of the smallest crowds in NFL postseason history, even with a sellout.) Next year, the stadium work will be so substantial that the Jaguars will relocate to Orlando for a season.

The ongoing stadium construction presents an opportunity for both Atlanta and Tampa to refine their big-event capabilities. Both cities have hosted Super Bowls, and both cities would be open to much more. Massive NFL stadiums, and the teams that own them, want to enhance their bottom lines with a piece of the lucrative college football Saturday experience.

"At Raymond James Stadium, we've always had double tenants, the Buccaneers, obviously, as well as the USF Bulls," says Lanness Robinson, executive director of the Tampa Bay Sports Commission. "USF is building their own on-campus stadium, so that means that there's going to be some availability at Raymond James Stadium. [Georgia-Florida in 2027] really gives us a sneak peek at the neutral-site game options that will now be there for us to consider how we're going to go forward, and what opportunities might exist out there."

"[Stadium] owners have put in hundreds of millions of dollars for stadiums that sit empty 350 days a year, because there's just not many World Cup games that you can put in there," says Victor Matheson, a professor of economics at Holy Cross. "There's not many Bruce Springsteens and Kendrick Lamars that can fill an entire NFL stadium. So you have these gigantic facilities that are wildly expensive that sit empty the vast majority of the time, so anything you can do to fill those up is a benefit and a little bit of gravy for those NFL owners."

College games in NFL stadiums: Here, and growing

Unless and until there are more college football games in a season — not out of the realm of possibility, but that's another story — the behemoth NFL stadiums will have to lure already-existing competitions to their buildings. And that presents a very real opportunity for universities … and a threat to fans who enjoy the on-campus experience.

In a world of spiraling NIL costs and financially strapped athletic departments, universities are looking for alternative sources of revenue, and moving a game from campus to an NFL stadium is a quick way to drum up some necessary revenue. Sometimes that's an easy switch … sometimes not.

In return for a $10 million check, Georgia Tech moved last year's installment of Clean Old-Fashioned Hate , its rivalry game with Georgia, to Mercedes-Benz Stadium. But that wasn't a significant lift; Tech's own stadium is just one mile away. More notable was Auburn's decision to move its season-opener against Baylor this year to Mercedes-Benz, more than two hours northeast of campus. Both Auburn and Baylor fans weren't pleased with the move , but then they weren't writing big enough checks to offset it.

From Florida's perspective, the game works on its own, but not as a pathway to other neutral-site games. "You're taking games away from campus, and we value those as well," Stricklin says. "The historic nature of Florida-Georgia makes that worth doing on an annual basis from a neutral site standpoint. … There might be a one-off here and there, but it's not something we're going to be very invested in for regular-season games."

Georgia's Kirby Smart has gone on record many times about his distaste for neutral-site games — coaches hate any disruption to routine, and Smart hates anything that cuts into his on-campus recruiting blitzes — but he's fighting a losing battle. Neutral-site games are just too lucrative for universities to resist for long.

For instance, according to the Athens Banner-Herald , Jacksonville is paying both universities $1.5 million apiece this year and next, even though the game isn't being played anywhere near Jacksonville . That figure rises to $10 million apiece in 2028 and 2029, and $10.5 million in 2030 and 2031.

Beyond that, who knows? Perhaps the two schools and Jacksonville will continue the arrangement that's worked so well for so long. And perhaps the schools will begin a profitable pilgrimage around the Southeast, rotating through the massive, competing stadiums in the region.

"We are going to maintain traditions, but also try to make it our own at the same time, because if they ever are looking for another place, we want to be considered," says Robinson of Tampa's 2027 hosting duties. "Jacksonville has done a great job with the game as long as they've had it. But if there's ever another opportunity for another renovation or whatever, we want to be right there and be great hosts, because we always are looking to bring events back."

"Restarting Florida-Georgia here in '28 is extremely important, because it's going to send an instant signal to all the other great sporting events that we want to hold in the new stadium," Corrigan says. "Everything from major concerts to football games. We want to be much more in the conversation about college football playoff late-round games."

The campus scheduling experience isn't dying, but it is changing.

"One of the exciting things about the expanded playoff is more on-campus game playoff games," Stricklin says. "We all have really cool stadiums on our campus, and we've got to make sure we continue to drive really compelling matchups to those campuses. I think the campus is always going to be the backbone of college football scheduling."

Stricklin speaks from a position of strength; he already has his lucrative neutral-site game locked in for the future. Will other ADs and institutions be quite so campus-focused with so much money on the line? That's very much an open question.

So raise a legally sanctioned beverage to the way Georgia-Florida, and college football as a whole, used to be. There's no guarantee it'll be that way going forward.

articles.title: College football's era of invincibility is over. Get used to everyone losing
articles.summary: For powerhouse programs and their fans, it's time to accept a new reality: Losing is inevitable, and even the biggest names aren't immune.
articles.body:
There's a feeling that comes over a stadium, a fan base that's in the process of losing a game it expected to win. There's usually a healthy dose of rage, to start, fury at those biased refs or an incompetent coaching staff or the players who just don't want it as much as they used to. But after the rage fades, the dread rolls in, the disbelief, the awareness that a bright and sunny future just got a bit — or a lot — darker.

Texas knows this feeling, thanks to Florida and Oklahoma. Ohio State felt it after falling to Texas, and coming within half a foot of losing to Indiana, too. BYU may not know exactly what happened in their loss to UCF, but they know what it felt like. Georgia knows it, thanks to Auburn, and Alabama knows it thanks to Tennessee. Everybody's kicking Oregon around. Miami and UCLA and Utah, your time is gonna come.

Welcome to the new reality of college football. Don't ever get too comfortable, because the losses are coming.

Right now, there are only three unbeaten FBS teams: No. 1 Miami, No. 9 UCLA and No. 10 Utah. The most recent time we've had so few unbeaten teams at this point in the season: 2003. As The Athletic notes , the average number of undefeated teams remaining after Week 8 in the 12-game playoff era is 7.8. That's so many more unbeaten teams than we have now! So many more fan bases that haven't had to make that long, "but what if we suck?" walk back to their tailgates after a humiliating loss!

The overarching reason for the increasing slide toward parity ought to be obvious: NIL and the transfer portal have led to a dispersal of talent across the college football universe. Where star recruits in, say, the Saban era might have accepted sitting behind fellow stars for a season or two, waiting for their opportunity, players now want the immediate payoff of a starting gig … and the NIL money that accompanies it. And that's totally understandable!

The downstream effects of this, though, will be fascinating to watch. The Athletic notes that the average number of undefeated teams in the NIL era (2021 to 2025) after Week 8 is 7.4, not all that different from the pre-NIL era — but then that's a pretty small sample size. (This year's three will pull that average down to 6.67.) In the coming years, absent any other changes to the current system, the shocking outcomes will become progressively less shocking.

Consider, for instance, team cohesion. A college program isn't a fantasy football team; you can't just throw together any random 11 players who accepted your NIL deal and expect them to post the same numbers at any stop. Quarterbacks and receivers, offensive and defensive lines, secondaries all need time to bond and connect as a team, learning each other's tendencies and having each other's backs.

Plus, consider the effect of injuries. Teams don't have the funds to invest in two full Saban-esque starter-level lineups, and most players won't take less when more is available elsewhere. So when a starter goes down, the backup might be ready … or might be a huge downgrade. (Oregon and Ohio State are both facing this exact challenge at quarterback.)

All of that combined leads to what we've seen over the last few weeks: No. 1s and No. 2s losing to unranked teams, fields getting stormed, fan bases in agony because they're still filtering these losses through their pre-NIL filters. The reality is, virtually every "elite" team is going to lose to an underdog in a given season, and probably more than once.

Where the unfamiliar pain is really going to kick in hard, however, is the playoff. There was a time not so long ago when you could count on college football's ruling elite the way you count on the sunrise. In the seven College Football Playoff installments of the pre-NIL , pre-portal era — i.e. the 2014 to 2020 seasons — Alabama and Clemson reached the playoff six times, Ohio State and Oklahoma four apiece. Georgia and Michigan have elbowed their way into the picture since then, making four and three post-2020 playoff appearances respectively, and each winning national titles along the way.

But like a club ditching its cover charge, the playoff is losing its exclusivity — and, by association, its cachet. A playoff berth alone isn't an honor for most top programs, it's table stakes for coaches to keep their jobs. And it just means more potential for heartbreak from an unexpected angle. More teams + more widely dispersed talent = more stunning upsets.

You can shrug off a loss to an underdog in September or October, particularly when everybody else is plummeting around you. But when it's December and you're down three possessions to an underdog in your campus stadium, well … that's when the real pain starts.

So what does this all mean for programs and their fans? For starters, maybe step back from the cliff every time your team loses a game. We all know hardcore fans who stress so badly over losses that they punch TVs, fight with relatives, put themselves into hospitals or poison trees; maybe it's time to counsel a bit of moderation.

In the big picture, bad September and October games now ruin weeks, not entire years. No single regular-season game will ever hold the same apocalyptic postseason importance again. Plus, when the dark, miserable cloud of loss does rain down on your team, take heart: You'll probably get the chance to do the same thing to someone else next week.

articles.title: Desvelados los votos de uno de los Balones de Oro más ajustados de la historia: solamente 28 puntos entre Kane y Mbappé
articles.standfirst: Lamine, tercero, se quedó a 139 puntos del segundo puesto
articles.summary: Lamine, tercero, se quedó a 139 puntos del segundo puesto
articles.body: Sin duda, uno de los Balones de Oro más ajustados de la historia esta edición del 2026. Y es que, días después de conocerse el triunfo de Harry Kane en Londres, L'Equipe y France Football han desvelado los votos del jurado y la clasificación definitiva. Solamente hubo 28 puntos entre Kane, ganador, y Mbappé, segundo. Es la cuarta diferencia más ajustada en la historia entre dos contendientes al Balón de Oro. 1. Harry Kane (Inglaterra, Bayern Múnich), 1.055 puntos. 2. Kylian Mbappé (Francia, Real Madrid), 1.027 puntos. 3. Lamine Yamal (España, FC Barcelona), 881 puntos. 4. Rodri (España, Manchester City, FC Barcelona desde agosto de 2026), 726 puntos. 5. Lionel Messi (Argentina, Inter Miami), 612 puntos. 6. Khvitcha Kvaratskhelia (Georgia, París Saint-Germain), 541 puntos. 7. Ousmane Dembélé (Francia, París Saint-Germain), 418 puntos. 8. Erling Haaland (Noruega, Manchester City), 378 puntos. 9. Michael Olise (Francia, Bayern Múnich), 296 puntos. 10. Fabián Ruiz (España, París Saint-Germain), 201 puntos. 11. Jude Bellingham (Inglaterra, Real Madrid), 107 pts. 12. Pau Cubarsi (España, FC Barcelona), 101 pts. 13. Achraf Hakimi (Marruecos, Paris Saint-Germain), 65 pts. 14. Vitinha (Portugal, Paris Saint-Germain), 59 pts. 15. Declan Rice (Inglaterra, Arsenal), 57 pts. 16. Ferran Torres (España, FC Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain desde agosto de 2026), 44 pts. 17. Vinicius Jr. (Brasil, Real Madrid), 26 pts. 18. Marc Cucurella (España, Real Madrid), 16 pts. 19. Joao Neves (Portugal, Paris Saint-Germain), 15 pts. 20. Willian Pacho (Ecuador, Paris Saint-Germain), 12 pts. 21. Gabriel (Brasil, Arsenal), 11 pts. 22. Lautaro Martínez (Argentina, Inter de Milán), 11 pts. 23. Nuno Mendes (Portugal, Paris Saint-Germain), 8 pts. 24. Luis Díaz (Colombia, Bayern de Múnich), 8 pts. 25. Marquinhos (Brasil, Paris Saint-Germain), 7 pts. 26. Dayot Upamecano (Francia, Bayern de Múnich), 5 pts. 27. Bruno Fernandes (Portugal, Manchester United), 5 pts. 28. Julián Quiñones (México, Al-Qadsiah), 4 pts. 29. Sadio Mané (Senegal, Al-Nassr), William Saliba (Francia, Arsenal), 2 pts. Harry Kane recibió 40 votos para el primer puesto, mientras que a Mabppé 'solamente' 23. El delantero del Bayern de Múnich se convirtió en 'su' Londres, donde se celebró la gala, en el primer inglés desde Michael Owen en 2001 en ganar el trofeo. Además, es el primer jugador del Bayern que lo gana desde Karl-Heinz Rummenigge en 1981. Como explica L'Equipe, el Balón de Oro es otorgado por un jurado internacional de 100 periodistas especializados, con un representante por país. El período de referencia abarcó desde el 3 de agosto de 2025 hasta el 19 de julio de 2026, tanto para el desempeño de clubes como de selecciones nacionales. El sistema de puntuación es el siguiente: 15 puntos para el primer lugar, 12 para el segundo, 10 para el tercero, y luego 8, 7, 5, 4, 3, 2 y 1 punto. En caso de empate en la clasificación final, los jugadores se desempatan según el número de veces que recibieron nominaciones para el primer lugar, luego para el segundo, para el tercero, y así sucesivamente.

articles.title: Tregua en Vallecas: el Rayo se reúne con su afición y se compromete a hacerlo una vez al mes
articles.standfirst: El club franjirrojo lo anunció por medio de un comunicado oficial
articles.summary: El cuadro franjirrojo lo anunció por medio de un comunicado oficial
articles.body: El Rayo Vallecano y las Peñas se siguen acercando. El club anunció la reunión entre ambas partes el pasado jueves día 29. Entre los temas que se trataron fue el reembolso de la parte proporcional de los abonos correspondiente a los partidos disputados en Butarque, la vuelta de la franja a las tres equipaciones de la temporada que viene y una reunión mensual con representantes de la afición. “Esta reunión ha supuesto un paso más hacia delante en la creación de una relación positiva entre el Club y sus aficionados” reza parte del escrito. Además en aquel encuentro, el club agradeció a los aficionados que ayudaron en el accidente ferroviario. Las Peñas denunciaron por sus redes sociales que acordaron con el club que el anuncio se realizara a las 15:00 horas del viernes día 30 y no a las 20:11. Rayo Vallecano de Madrid comunica que en la tarde de ayer se mantuvo una reunión con representantes de la afición, con la firme intención de alcanzar una situación de normalidad en la relación entre el Club y sus aficionados que permita a la plantilla contar con su apoyo, algo indispensable para lograr los objetivos deportivos. En esta reunión, además de los acuerdos alcanzados y que expondremos a continuación, se asumió el compromiso de seguir manteniendo una comunicación fluida que permita también avanzar en otros puntos clave de interés para ambas partes. En el encuentro se trataron los siguientes puntos: - La compensación por los partidos que, por causas ajenas al Club, tuvimos que disputar en el Estadio Ontime Butarque se calculará dividiendo el precio total de cada abono en cada sector entre el número de partidos incluidos y multiplicando el resultado por el número de encuentros a los que el abonado no pudo acudir en Leganés. El Club sigue trabajando en la operativa que permita llevar a cabo dicha compensación de la manera más cómoda para el abonado. Tal y como acordamos ayer, esperamos tener en los próximos días una propuesta clara que podamos comunicar y hacer efectiva. - Las tres equipaciones de la temporada 27/28 contarán con la franja como elemento protagonista. - En la reunión de ayer el Club se comprometió a mantener una reunión mensual con representantes de la afición con el fin de afianzar una comunicación cercana que nos permita, a unos y a otros, conocer las inquietudes y realidades que nos afectan. Además, como anunciábamos al inicio, en las próximas reuniones se seguirá trabajando en otros puntos de interés para ambas partes. Esta reunión ha supuesto un paso más hacia delante en la creación de una relación positiva entre el Club y sus aficionados, que esperamos que tendrá su eco mañana con el apoyo al equipo en el partido frente al Real Club Celta de Vigo. No queremos concluir el comunicado sin agradecer a todos los aficionados del Rayo Vallecano que el otro día acudieron el lugar del terrible accidente para prestar su ayuda. Ayer pudimos transmitírselo en persona, y es justo poder volver a mencionarlo. Gracias.

images.caption: Raúl Martín Presa, en Vallecas el día del partido ante el Athletic.

articles.title: Un Achraf de '10' hace aun más líder al PSG
articles.standfirst: Goleada de los parisinos antes de enfrentarse al Villarreal en Champions
articles.summary: Goleada de los parisinos antes de enfrentarse al Villarreal en Champions
articles.body: Jornada previa a la Champions, partido fuera de casa, muchas rotaciones y empezar perdiendo. Demasiados obstáculos que, sin embargo, el PSG sorteó para acabar goleando al Le Havre y ser más líder de una Ligue 1 que ya domina de forma clara. Achraf Hakimi fue el líder absoluto de la 'manita' parisina con un 'hat-trick' más dos asistencias. Show total del marroquí mientras que Luis Enrique, con 127 triunfos, supera a Blanc como el entrenador más ganador en la historia del PSG. Tras jugar el lunes y en la previa de viajar a España para medirse al Villarreal en Champions, Luis Enrique apostó por las rotaciones. Sin Dembélé, Kvaratskhelia, Marquinhos o Nuno Mendes por lesión, fue día de banquillo para Doué, Joao Neves, Pacho, Fabián o Vitinha. Dro y Ferran, partían de inicio. Y el gol de Josh Maja (ex protagonista de la famosa serie 'Sunderland 'Til I Die') pasado el cuarto de hora parecía complicar todo. Pero fue una acción aislada en un partido que controlaron los de 'Lucho' en todo momento. En dos minutos, antes de la media hora, el PSG remontaba: primero Godts a pase de Achraf, después el propio capitán del equipo capitalino. Ya en la segunda parte, el ex del Madrid, Dortmund o Inter completaba su 'show' con dos goles más: uno de falta y otro con algo de fortuna, tras un rebote, pero demostrando de nuevo su hambre y presencia en área rival. El Le Havre, que intentó maquillar el marcador con un cabezazo de Maja al palo, solamente pudo ver como, en esa misma jugada, Mayulu anotaba al contagolpe. Fue después cuando Hakimi hizo el quinto para redondear la 'manita'. El PSG, que aprovechó la goleada del Niza al Stade Rennais (segundo), es más líder y ya saca cuatro puntos al segundo a la espera de saber qué hacen Lille, Mónaco o Lyon.

images.caption: Achraf celebra uno de los goles ante el Le Havre. PSG.

articles.title: Foyth, pendiente de pruebas: es duda para recibir al PSG
articles.standfirst: El defensa argentino causó baja ante el Espanyol
articles.summary: El defensa argentino pasará pruebas para conocer el alcance de sus molestias musculares
articles.body: La ausencia de Juan Foyth en la convocatoria del Villarreal para enfrentarse al Espanyol ha encendido las alarmas respecto al estado físico del argentino. El defensa de La Plata, que fue titular en la reciente victoria amarilla en cancha del Valencia, causa baja para esta jornada a causa de unas molestias musculares tal y como confirmó el propio Villarreal. Foyth regresó esta temporada a los terrenos de juego después de una larga ausencia de siete meses a causa de una grave lesión en el tendón de Aquiles. Una inactividad que les ha pasado factura ya que durante esta misma temporada ya sufrió una lesión muscular que le apartó durante varias semanas. De esta forma el argentino se convierte en seria duda de cara al atractivo partido de Liga de Campeones que los amarillos disputarán el próximo martes en el Estadio de la Cerámica ante el PSG. El interrogante del argentino se une al de Nathan Saliba y Alassanne Diatta, ambos ausentes en el día de hoy ante el cuadro perico y también por molestias musculares de diferente consideración.

images.caption: Foyth saluda a Fer Niño en el Villarreal-Elche.

articles.title: China votó quinto a Mbappé en el Balón de Oro... antes de 'la crisis del meme'
articles.standfirst: La votación se cerró días antes de que estallara el conflicto entre Mbappé y el país asiático
articles.summary: La votación se cerró días antes de que estallara el conflicto entre Mbappé y el país asiático
articles.body: Luo Ming, periodista de 'Titan Sports' y representante de China en el jurado del Balón de Oro 2026, votó a Kylian Mbappé en quinta posición. Una situación que contrasta con la relación rota que hay a día de hoy entre el país oriental y el futbolista galo después de que saliera a la luz un clip de una entrevista en la que el delantero del Real Madrid bromeaba sobre un 'meme' que lo relacionaba con Mao Zedong. La polémica, masiva y que ha creado una brecha quizás irreparable en las relaciones entre el fútbol español y China, era inexistente en el momento en el que Luo Ming tuvo que enviar sus votos a L'Equipe y France Football. Sus votos al Balón de Oro colocaron primero a Leo Messi, segundo a Dembélé y tercero a Rodri. Curiosamente, ninguno del top-3 final. Mbappé, quinto, estaba por detrás de Kane. Lamine fue el sexto. Cabe destacar que los únicos tres países que no votaron a Mbappé dentro de su top-10 fueron Grecia, Ucrania y Escocia. Es decir, estos países no dieron ningún punto a Kylian en su candidatura. Los únicos que no dieron puntos a Kane, por otro lado, fueron Costa de Marfil y México. Solamente 28 puntos separaron al ganador del segundo, la cuarta clasificación más apretada de la historia del galardón.

images.caption: Kylian Mbappé, en la gala del Balón de Oro 2026. EFE.

articles.title: Gerard Moreno cae lesionado y peligra el PSG
articles.standfirst: El delantero fue sustituido en el minuto 17 de partido ante el Espanyol
articles.summary: El delantero fue sustituido en el minuto 17 de partido ante el Espanyol
articles.body: Gerard Moreno parecía haber dejado atrás su mala racha de lesiones en la presente temporada... hasta el partido de este viernes ante el Espanyol. El delantero del Villarreal, que solo se había quedado sin jugar esta temporada en dos partidos -por decisión técnica-, cayó lesionado ante su exequipo a los 17 minutos de partido y tuvo que ser sustituido por Pépé. El peor momento, con el choque ante el PSG de Champions League a la vuelta de la esquina. Ahora falta por ver qué resultados dan las pruebas pertinentes al delantero amarillo, que se fue al suelo y pidió el cambio por unas molestias musculares. Gerard, que en las últimas temporadas no había encontrado la continuidad deseada por las numerosas lesiones sufridas, parecía haber dejado atrás esta temporada ese calvario. Sin embargo, el punta del Villarreal vuelve a sufrir un percance físico que podría apartarle, además, del próximo duelo europeo ante el PSG. Gerard Moreno se suma al capítulo de dudas para el encuentro ante el equipo francés, tras conocerse la ausencia de Juan Foyth en la convocatoria del partido de este viernes, también por unos problemas musculares.

articles.title: Coroner: Southern Nazarene player died after suffering traumatic brain injury, brain bleed from helmet-to-helmet hit
articles.summary: Tyler Ulrich died days after he was injured in his team's Oct. 10 game against Ouachita Baptist.
articles.body:
Southern Nazarene football player Tyler Ulrich died after suffering a traumatic brain injury and subsequent brain bleed.

Ulrich, 21, died days after he was injured in Division II SNU's game against Ouachita Baptist on Oct. 10. The game was stopped for 45 minutes as he received medical attention on the field and he had been hospitalized in critical condition. At the time, Southern Nazarene had only said that Ulrich suffered a "traumatic injury."

ESPN obtained a copy of the Garland County Coroner's Office report regarding Ulrich's death. The report said that Ulrich's subdural hematoma was caused by a helmet-to-helmet hit.

The school told ESPN that it had not yet seen the report.

"Our university president, football team and coaches participated in a Celebration of Life service for Tyler last Sunday afternoon in Azle, Texas. The report you mentioned has not been provided to us," the spokesperson said in a statement provided to ESPN. "Our campus community is faithfully remembering his family, teammates and coaches in our prayers."

Ulrich's death is the second of the college football season related to game action. In Week 1 of the NAIA season in August, William Jewell running back MicahJo Barnett died after he collapsed on the sideline shortly after a touchdown run. Barnett's cause of death has not been publicly released.

Additionally, Mayview State quarterback Matt Donovan was placed in a medically induced coma after he suffered a helmet-to-helmet hit on Sept. 19. Donovan was transferred on Oct. 19 to a rehabilitation facility in Nebraska that specializes in recovery from traumatic brain injuries. His father Terry said that two days before Donovan was transferred , Matt was able to open his eyes for extended periods of time.

articles.title: Sergio García enseña el camino a Sarabia
articles.standfirst: El técnico interino asalta La Cerámica y acaba con la mala racha del Espanyol
articles.summary: El técnico interino asalta La Cerámica y acaba con la mala racha del Espanyol
articles.body: Cambió de entrenador el Espanyol y se cumplió esa máxima del fútbol de "A entrenador nuevo... victoria segura". Asaltó el Espanyol La Cerámica e hizo que el Villarreal pagase los platos rotos con un gol de Cabrera. Éder Sarabia, en la grada, tomó buena nota. El Espanyol tiene pulso y solo hacía falta un buena maniobra para reanimarlo. Visita a los de Iñigo Pérez era un envite apropiado para ello. Sí, suena raro, pero este año visitar La Cerámica se ha convertido en un chollo. Van cinco partidos y el equipo amarillo ha sufrido tres derrotas, dejándose 11 de los 15 puntos en juego. Excesivo para un equipo cuyas aspiraciones son pelear por Europa. El Espanyol le puso más alma al partido, más intención... y más pegada. Mientras los de Sergio García firmaban un partido completísimo, el Villarreal daba la sensación de quedarse a medias. Como tantas otras veces esta temporada. Intermitente, con poco ritmo en muchas fases del partido y sin un jugador que asumiese el peso ofensivo del equipo. Ese rol, que solía asumir Gerard Moreno, se esfumó cuando pasado el cuarto de hora el delantero revivía sus peores pesadillas, en pleno halloween, con una nueva lesión muscular. Ni siquiera el Villarreal sometió a su rival con el balón como arma. Esa posesión que pocas veces se le discute a los de amarillo tampoco fue una aliada de los de Iñigo Pérez. Poca continuidad, con escasas transiciones y sin encontrar un dominio territorial claro alrededor de la pelota. Apenas un par de buenas apariciones de Sergi Cardona que hicieron dudar a la zaga perica. Empezó a crecer el equipo de Sergio García, que ya avisó con un gol bien anulado a Roberto por un agarrón previo sobre Pau Navarro. La siguiente llegada fue la que decantó el partido del lado del equipo catalán. Un centro medido de Javi Hernández y un remate de Cabrera de puro nuevo confirmaron la catástrofe amarilla. Tocado y hundido. Ni siquiera la entrada de Ayoze, Oluwaseyi y cía cambió el escenario. Mientras Pépé y Buchanan acumulaban intentos fallidos, el Espanyol crecía en su labor defensiva, con Drkusic en plan estelar. Entre él y Fortuño apagaron las pocas fogatas -fuego sería decir demasiado- que pudo encender el Villarreal en el tramo final de partido. El incendio ahora está en La Cerámica, donde cualquier equipo que pasa por allí deja un aspecto desolador para los de Iñigo. Y en cuatro días llega el PSG. Como para no asustarse.

articles.title: Sergio García y su revolución dan con la tecla
articles.standfirst: El técnico perico ha logrado sumar los tres puntos en su estreno de forma interina ante el Villarreal
articles.summary: El técnico perico ha logrado sumar los tres puntos en su estreno de forma interina ante el Villarreal
articles.body: La semana en Barcelona ha sido de las más extrañas que se recuerdan y, para redondearla, el Espanyol se ha llevado los tres puntos en su vista al estadio de La Cerámica gracias a un tanto de Cabrera en el 60’. Con un Sergio García que se sentaba en el banquillo perico como interino a la espera de que pueda hacerlo Eder Sarabia, el que fuera técnico blanquiazul ha planteado una pequeña revolución que le ha dado grandes resultados sobre el césped. El Espanyol se presentaba en Vila-real con una convocatoria con varios y notables cambios, dejando a futbolistas de peso como Urko, Caltrava o Riedel en Barcelona y apostando por los jóvenes de la Dani Jarque. Con seis canteranos en el once inicial saltaba el conjunto perico al encuentro, más otros cuatro que ingresarían al partido en el segundo tiempo. Conocedor del filial del Espanyol, Sergio García ha apostado por ello y le ha sacado el máximo partido. Con Alejandro Santiago debutando como titular esta noche, firmando una actuación de mucho nivel, o con jugadores como Jan Peries o José Ángel teniendo una participación importante en la segunda mitad. Sin complejos y con mucha valentía ha afrontado el encuentro un Sergio García que sale totalmente reforzado de cara a un futuro como técnico blanquiazul. Tres puntos importantes que le sirven al Espanyol para coger aire y salir de los puestos de descenso

articles.title: Alerta en el Sporting por César Gelabert
articles.standfirst: El mediapunta palentino sufre una lesión en la rodilla y se someterá a pruebas médicas en los próximos días
articles.summary: El mediapunta palentino sufre una lesión en la rodilla y se someterá a pruebas médicas en los próximos días
articles.body: Nueva lesión en el Sporting de Gijón. El conjunto rojiblanco perderá a César Gelabert por una lesión en la rodilla sufrida este viernes y será baja en la visita al Alfonso Murube. El mediapunta palentino se someterá a una resonancia magnética el próximo lunes con el objetivo de determinar el alcance de la lesión y la recuperación a seguir. Mazazo para Nicolás Larcamón. Baja muy sensible en los planes del Sporting de Gijón. El canterano del Real Madrid, que es una figura clave para Nicolás Larcamón, acumula diez titularidades y sola una expulsión evitó el pleno de participaciones en la presente temporada. Una ausencia todavía más delicada por la falta de alternativas con la que cuenta el Sporting en su posición. Una nueva lesión de rodilla en el historial de César Gelabert. A la espera de conocer los resultados de las pruebas médicas, un problema en la rodilla volverá a frenar al mediapunta, que ya sufrió dos lesiones de gravedad en la misma zona en sus etapas en la cantera del Madrid y en el Mirandés. La baja de Gelabert supone un nuevo contratiempo físico para el Sporting de Gijón, que ya cuenta en su enfermería con Konrad, Manu Rodríguez, Nikita Iosifov, Andrés Ferrari y Antonio Casas. Una plaga de lesiones que ataca a un nuevo miembro de la plantilla rojiblanca y que sigue lastrando las opciones de Nicolás Larcamón.

articles.title: El Alcorcón priva al Madrileño de volver a ganar en el último minuto
articles.standfirst: Ambos equipos se reparten el botín en un derbi repleto de alternativas y en el que el filial golpeó primero, pero que el Alcor igualó en el último suspiro
articles.summary: Ambos equipos se reparten el botín en un derbi repleto de alternativas y en el que el filial golpeó primero, pero que el Alcor igualó en el último suspiro
articles.body: Un gol de Javi Lancho, en el 96’, salvó un punto para el Alcorcón ante el Atlético Madrileño, que ya saboreaba las mieles de la victoria tras seis partidos y mes y medio sin ganar, pero que se quedó sin el tan ansiado botín. Los de Fernando Torres, que habían sufrido mucho en la primera mitad, se adelantaron con un tanto de Marc Domenech al inicio de la segunda parte; y, cuando ya se veían vencedores, vieron cómo el Alcor, que no dejó de intentarlo en ningún momento, igualaba al final para repartir los puntos en Alcalá. El encuentro que abría la jornada (junto al que medía a Ibiza y Europa) comenzó, como no podía ser de otro modo, con un emocionante y respetuoso minuto de silencio en recuerdo de las personas fallecidas en el trágico accidente de tren de Urda. Sigue sin apetecer demasiado hablar de fútbol, pero, para bien o para mal, el mundo sigue girando. Y el balón, también. Así lo puso de evidencia el Alcorcón, que comenzó llevando mucho peligro por la izquierda y tuvo la primera a los cinco minutos, cuando Omar buscó a Davo en el área en una acción que despejó como pudo Miguel Gil y que a punto estuvo de terminar en susto para el Madrileño en la víspera de Halloween. La réplica del Madrileño no tardó en llegar, con una volea cruzada de Domenech que, en su primer aviso, chutó el balón fuera del arco de Miguel Bañuz por poco. Pero el Alcor había salido con una marcha más y generaba mucho peligro por la izquierda, con Miguel Cuesta y Omar como dos puñales. El segundo, un auténtico torbellino, tuvo una clarísima tras un gran regate en el área, pero Astralaga respondió con una gran parada. Igual que unos instantes después, cuando sacó una mano tremenda para salvar un remate de Davo que se colaba. En la otra área, por su parte, también se tuvo que lucir Bañuz, que le sacó una volea a bocajarro a Jorge Castillo tras un córner. Pero las mejores seguían siendo para el Alcor. Omar volvió a tenerla con un misil a la escuadra que se marchó por poco; antes de que Cuesta firmase una gran jugada individual que a punto estuvo de acabar en gol antes del descanso. El Alcor estaba perdonando y, ya se sabe, hay una máxima infranqueable del fútbol que señala que, cuando eso sucede, se suele pagar. Y así le pasó a los de Fran Justo: al poco de iniciarse la segunda mitad, Domenech cazó un balón tras un córner y lo mandó para dentro. Jarro de agua helada para el Alcorcón, que pudo incluso ser peor cuando, minutos después, Bañuz salvó con un paradón otra diablura de Domenech. Tras ello, el Alcor intentó despertar y se volvió a volcar sobre la meta del filial. Irurita se topó con Astralaga tras un córner y Melero tuvo otra clarísima, pero, con el partido agonizando, Javi Lancho, un central con alma de delantero, aprovechó un gran pase de Aparicio tras un fallo del Madrileño en la salida de balón para ajusticiar a Astralaga y sacar un punto ‘in extremis’ para un conjunto, el alfarero, que hizo honor a su lema: ‘Hasta el último minuto del último partido’. articles.title: Sergio García: “Hoy se ha visto a un gran equipo”
articles.standfirst: El técnico se mostraba muy feliz tras su debut con victoria en el banquillo del Espanyol
articles.summary: El técnico se mostraba muy feliz tras su debut con victoria en el banquillo del Espanyol
articles.body: El Espanyol ha sumado una victoria de gran valor ante el Villarreal. El tanto de Cabrera en el 60 de partido tras rematar un buen centro de Bryan Zaragoza le ha dado los tres puntos al equipo perico. Un triunfo que le da mucha aire al conjunto blanquiazul tras el baile de entrenadores que se ha producido esta semana y rompe con la mala racha de resultados que arrastraba el equipo. Sergio García, pese a hacerlo de forma interina, se ha estrenado a lo grande y con tres puntos muy importantes para el club. El técnico comparecía tras el encuentro ante los medios y se mostraba muy satisfecho. Confianza para revertir la situación: “Cuando no hay una buena dinámica, que yo lo he vivido, es creérselo. Confiar en ellos e intentar juntarse, creer en el compañero que lo va a hacer bien y creer que tú también lo haces. Y la verdad que hoy se ha visto un gran equipo. Hemos sido un equipo. Y bueno, contento por ellos porque venían de una dinámica mala. No me gusta que el Espanyol pase por esa racha. Se creyeran al final que son grandes jugadores porque el año pasado hicieron muy buenos partidos. Este año han hecho algún buen partido, los resultados no han sido los mejores y se ha visto la mejor versión del equipo. Creo que los tres puntos son muy importantes y más en un campo como el del Villarreal”. Sobre el mensaje al equipo en un momento difícil: “Cuando vienes de una dinámica que no es buena, te viene la Copa y te eliminan. Al final es normal, la gente se viene abajo, están cabizbajos, no tienen esa ilusión, esas ganas. Pero yo los cogí y les dije, “oye, ya ha pasado, vamos a hacer borrón y cuenta nueva, vamos a juntarnos, vamos a disfrutar”. El fútbol es muy bonito y hay que disfrutarlo. Al final pueden obtener los resultados, puede ganar, puede perder, pero si tú tienes compromiso con el compañero, contigo mismo y siempre das todo en el campo, al final te puedes ir tranquilo a casa. Y creo que hoy el equipo lo ha dado todo”. Una apuesta exitosa por los jóvenes de la casa: “Yo quiero que los chicos vayan para arriba y nutrir al primer equipo. Yo sé que, bueno, egoístamente a lo mejor podría decir no, que no jueguen, no. Al final yo quiero que los chicos vayan para arriba y cuantos más, mucho mejor. Y si él tiene que confiar en ellos, nosotros estamos aquí. No se pueden relajar, que lo tienen al alcance de la mano y con trabajo y sacrificio al final las cosas llegan. Como los veo en el día a día, me encantan. Son buenos jugadores. Incluso también tenemos a más gente que está dando mucho nivel. Nosotros estamos intentando sacarles lo mejor para que algún día puedan pasar lo que ha pasado hoy, que creo que se lo merecen. No han desentonado para nada. Incluso yo creo que han estado muy bien. Y ojalá puedan ser más. Yo sé que el primer equipo tiene grandes jugadores, pero los chicos están ahí, van a luchar por en algún momento poder estar ahí y quiero felicitarlos por su debut y por el momento que están viviendo, porque han hecho que el equipo también consiga una buena victoria”. Un planteamiento para tener el balón: “Tenía claro cómo debíamos jugarle al Villarreal. Creo que por momentos, si lo hubiéramos creído incluso aún más, podíamos hacer daño. Son buenos futbolistas, son grandes jugadores y tienen que tener la pelota, yo creo. Y lo han hecho. Incluso ha habido momentos que, si se lo creyeran, podían haber tenido más la pelota. Creo que le hemos ido de tú a tú al Villarreal en muchos momentos, quedarnos la pelota, tener personalidad, ir hacia adelante, que no nos queme el balón. Esa era la premisa que les hemos dado a los chicos, que si nos quedamos la pelota ellos podían sufrir también. Y la verdad que hay que agradecer que los chicos hayan dado ese pasito hacia adelante porque al final nos ha valido para conseguir tres puntos”. Sobre la propuesta de Eder Sarabia: “La idea que tiene el míster Eder, que yo lo he visto, también es la idea de tener la pelota, porque creo que tenemos jugadores para tenerla. Y bueno, supongo yo que será esa línea, no lo sé. No he hablado de la idea que tiene, pero viendo el año pasado que estuvo entrenando al Elche, pues es parecido y supongo yo que será por ahí la línea del equipo”.

articles.title: Andrea Cambiaso: Man United join the race for Juventus ace as INEOS look to reinforce key position in January
articles.summary: One area that Manchester United need to reinforce as early as possible is at left-back, where Michael Carrick is short on specialist options.Luke Shaw may ha...
articles.body:
One area that Manchester United need to reinforce as early as possible is at left-back, where Michael Carrick is short on specialist options.

Luke Shaw may have started every Premier League game last season, but the Englishman's injury troubles have returned to haunt him.

The 31-year-old has already missed seven games this season, leaving the head coach to utilise centre-back Ayden Heaven and right-backs Diogo Dalot and Noussair Mazraoui as stop-gap options on the left.

Everyone knew it would be a risk not to sign a left-sided full-back in the summer, but the Red Devils' single-minded focus on midfielders meant Lewis Hall remained at Newcastle .

The England international is unlikely to make the jump in the middle of the current campaign, which is why INEOS are now widening their search.

442 have revealed that Juventus' Andrea Cambiaso is on United's radar, and while the Bianconeri would prefer to keep the Italian, an offer in the region of €30-40 million could be enough to sign him as early as January.

"The Juventus player is contractually bound to the Turin club until 2029. Club officials have so far rejected all offers and inquiries. The bosses are demanding a transfer fee in the range of 30 to 40 million euros."

The 20-time English league champions will not find it easy to sign the 26-year-old, given the interest of clubs such as Barcelona, Arsenal and Manchester City.

Liverpool, Chelsea, Tottenham Hotspur, Inter Milan and Napoli are also monitoring the situation, further complicating matters.

"According to information from 4-4-2.ch, clubs are lining up for the versatile player. FC Barcelona could make a move for him if Alejandro Balde can be sold as planned. The Catalan club is even preparing an offer of 20 to 25 million euros. A player swap is also a possibility.

"Arsenal and Manchester City, in particular, are closely monitoring the situation surrounding Cambiaso in the Premier League. Both clubs are currently remaining silent, but this could change in January.

"Other interested parties include Liverpool, Manchester United, Chelsea, Tottenham Hotspur, Inter Milan and Napoli."

INEOS need to decide their left-back plans soon

Andrea Cambiaso is not only accomplished as a left-back, but he can also play further forward as well as on the opposite flank.

It will be interesting to see if INEOS cough up the money in January or if they opt to keep their powder dry in their hopes of signing Hall next summer .

articles.title: Aston Villa plans to sue ex-player for 'unacceptable insults' on podcast
articles.summary: Premier League Club Aston Villa says it will take legal action against pundit and ex-player Jamie Carragher for comments he made on a podcast.
articles.body:
Aston Villa has released a statement, signed by club chairman Nassef Sawiris, saying it will take legal action against Jamie Carragher for comments the pundit and former player made on a podcast.

Appearing on " Stick To Football , " the former Liverpool defender suggested that while he respected Villa manager Unai Emery's work at Aston Villa, the manager could still weigh a move to a struggling Manchester United team because of its traditional place in global soccer's pecking order.

"I mentioned Unai Emery and have had loads of Villa fans on my case on social media which is absolutely fine," he said, continuing, "Surely he would want that opportunity to manage a giant again. I'm not trying to annoy you, Villa fans.

"But there is a chain in football, whether you like it or not. So, Real Madrid will take Man U's best player, they'll take Ronaldo. There's a few above Manchester United, above Liverpool. And there will be teams below Aston Villa, and they'll take their manager or take their players, so shut the (expletive) up, Aston Villa fans. You know what I mean? Aston Villa will never be Man United."

Best Premier League action, scenes and drama from 2026-27 season

But Villa fans have continued to express their frustration, with Carragher again explaining his comments on a different show on the same podcast network. That, also, was not enough to cool the situation, with the Europa League champion now saying it plans to see the commentator in court.

"Aston Villa will initiate legal action against Jamie Carragher for his unacceptable insults about the Club and its fans," reads a statement attributed to Sawiris. "Aston Villa will not allow anyone to stop our ascension in English and European football."

Villa currently sits ninth in the Premier League table and sits second in the UEFA Champions League table through three matches in the league stage, having won all three of their European games so far.

The club has a rich history, having won the Champions League in 1981-82 when it was called the European Cup. The Europa League win in 2025-26 was the first European trophy for Aston Villa since it lifted the 2001 Intertoto Cup, a lower-tier competition than either the Champions League or Europa League.

Sawiris, an Egyptian billionaire who is on the Board of Trustees at his alma mater the University of Chicago, has run the club since being part of a group that acquired it in 2018 when it was in the second division.

articles.body:
A cidade de Itu, no interior de São Paulo, é conhecida pelos objetos grandes. Mas, dessa vez, foi um doce com impressionantes 23,7 quilos que chamou a atenção em Vila Velha , na Grande Vitória. Preparado por um grupo de amigos após uma partida de futebol, o pudim gigante arrancou comemorações na hora de ser desenformado após a "pelada". (assista ao vídeo acima)

Para preparar a sobremesa, foram usados 90 ovos, 22 caixas de leite condensado, dez caixas de creme de leite e nove litros de leite. O resultado foi compartilhado em um vídeo que mostra a empolgação dos participantes com o tamanho do doce.

A receita foi preparada durante um dos encontros promovidos pelo grupo Pelada Galera-ES Green Ball , que se reúne smepre às terças-feiras para jogar futebol e confraternizar. A tradição já dura 14 anos e, depois das partidas, os integrantes costumam preparar diferentes pratos para compartilhar entre os amigos presentes.

O empresário Eleomar Mognato, um dos fundadores do grupo e responsável pela receita, contou ao g1 que a ideia de fazer um pudim surgiu durante uma dessas confraternizações.

"Depois do futebol, temos aquela resenha entre amigos. É onde falamos do nosso trabalho e nossas experiências. Um dia, tivemos a ideia de fazer um pudim de leite condensado. Futebol, churrasco e pudim", contou.

O doce gigante é resultado de uma tradição que cresceu aos poucos. O primeiro pudim preparado pelo grupo pesava cinco quilos. Depois, vieram versões de nove e 15 quilos, até chegar à receita mais recente, com quase 24 quilos (pouco mais de 25 kg contando a panela).

Amigos do grupo Pelada Galera-ES Green Ball fazem pudim gigante de quase 24 quilos no Espírito Santo — Foto: Reprodução

Para conseguir desenformar um pudim tão grande sem que ele se quebrasse, Eleomar precisou adaptar a receita e aumentar a quantidade de ovos para dar mais consistência à sobremesa.

"O pudim de cinco quilos ficou bom. No de nove, percebi que seria necessário colocar um ovo a mais em cada receita para dar mais consistência e o pudim não quebrar. Depois, veio o de nove e 15 kg. O mais atual, de 23, também deu muito certo", explicou.

Outro integrante da pelada, Bruno Nogueira, contou que os amigos costumam desafiar Eleomar a preparar pudins cada vez maiores, principalmente em datas comemorativas do grupo.

"O pudim já tem uma certa tradição. Sempre combinamos e desafiamos o Eleomar para fazer em alguma data de comemoração da turma", disse.

O sucesso da última receita já deu origem a um novo desafio: preparar um pudim de 30 quilos.

"Agora que o de 23 quilos deu certo, a meta é fazer o de 30 kg. Também aguardamos um tempo para criar ansiedade na galera", contou Eleomar.

O atual presidente do grupo, Rodrigo Cesar, destacou que a confraternização semanal se tornou uma parte importante da amizade entre os participantes.

"Nós fazemos essa confraternização semanalmente, após as 22h de terça-feira. O nosso grupo é muito unido e esse pudim se tornou a nossa pérola", afirmou.

Pudim pode ser o maior do Espírito Santo?

O tamanho da sobremesa também levantou uma dúvida entre os integrantes: será que eles fizeram o maior pudim do Espírito Santo?

"Pelo que a gente pesquisou, nunca vimos ninguém fazer um pudim maior no Espírito Santo. Acredito que o nosso seja o maior", disse Rodrigo.

Apesar da suspeita dos amigos, não há confirmação de que a receita tenha estabelecido um recorde estadual.

Enquanto planejam o próximo desafio, os integrantes do grupo seguem com a tradição de reunir futebol, comida e amizade. E, se depender da turma, o pudim de quase 24 quilos pode ser apenas mais uma etapa: o próximo deverá pesar 30 quilos.

articles.summary: Former star quarterback Philip Rivers has "emerged as the focus" of NC State's head coaching search, according to On3.com's Chris Low, Brett McMurphy and Pete Nakos.
articles.body:
Former star quarterback Philip Rivers has "emerged as the focus" of NC State's head coaching search, according to On3.com's Chris Low, Brett McMurphy and Pete Nakos .

Low, McMurphy and Nakos noted that there isn't a timetable for Rivers' hiring as he finishes out the 2026 season as head coach of St. Michael Catholic High School in Alabama.

NC State previously fired head coach Dave Doeren after dropping to 3-4 to start its 2026 campaign.

ESPN's Pete Thamel initially reported that Rivers was under consideration for the Wolfpack's vacancy on Saturday.

Prior to Rivers' impressive NFL career in which he earned eight Pro Bowl nods and made seven playoff appearances, he suited up for NC State for four seasons from 2000-03.

It's also worth noting that his son, Gunner, plays quarterback in high school and committed to the Wolfpack on Feb. 23. The 17-year-old is a 4-star prospect who's listed as the No. 12 passer in the 2027 recruiting class, per 247Sports' composite rankings .

As for the elder Rivers, he's helped lead St. Michael Catholic to a 6-3 record as head coach this season. The school previously advanced to the Class 4A semifinals in the state playoffs in each of the past two years.

While it's obviously much more challenging to coach at the college level compared to high school, Rivers' NFL experience and familiarity with NC State have reportedly made him a top choice for the school's next head coach.

articles.title: Bernardo Silva aclara las ideas del Madrid de Mourinho y mejora la posesión
articles.standfirst: Se puso el mono de trabajo para encontrar su sitio en el once
articles.summary: Se puso el mono de trabajo para encontrar su sitio en el once
articles.body: El Real Madrid de Mourinho parece que ya ha encontrado el camino. No solo es un movimiento del entrenador lo que ha cambiado, casi todos desde la remontada en Roma, pero el más significativo es el de Bernardo Silva. Su notable mejoría y presencia en el equipo va directamente relacionado con el subidón del equipo, confirmado con su gran partido en el Camp Nou. Mourinho ha tenido paciencia y ha esperado el tiempo que hiciera falta para meter al luso en el once. Con la parte de arriba superpoblada y con jugadores que superan a Bernardo en velocidad y físico, el entrenador pensó que lo mejor es meterle por dentro y más atrás para solucionar la falta de claridad en el juego con Valverde y Tchouaméni en el doble pivote. Pero el encargo requería esfuerzo y mucho despliegue en una zona donde hay que tener piernas y el entrenador ha esperado hasta que el luso ha cogido su mejor forma física. El temor antes del duelo es que el Barça ganara el choque con la mejor arma que se presupone, con el medio campo, pero no fue así y eso habla del acierto del técnico. Ante el Barça, Bernardo Silva sorprendió por su trabajo oscuro defendiendo y tapando las línea de pase de Rodri y Pedri. A eso añadió como ya se vio ante la Roma salida de balón desde atrás, liberando a Tchouaméni de esas funciones o repartiéndolas, lo que mejoró también al francés. Mou dejó bien claro en pretemporada que Bernardo necesitaría más tiempo para llegar a su mejor nivel porque por su forma de ser no le iba bien trabajar en las vacaciones, pero el momento ha llegado. Mou ya vio brotes verdes muy claros con Silva ante el Sevilla y el Lepizgig, éste segundo duelo ya como titular, donde el Madrid mejoró la posesión, incluso en el primer tiempo más bien flojo ante los alemanes. Salvo el duelo ante el Barça, donde el Madrid dejó un 37% de posesión, la misma asciende cuando está el luso en el campo a una media del 57%, sin él es de un 47% y en el balance general en lo que va de temporada pasa al 52%. Contra el Leipzig, el Madrid alcanzó un 62% de posesión. Ante la Roma, por contra, en la que el luso jugó los últimos 20 minutos, fue solo del 46%. Sin un fichaje en la medular, ni Rodri ni una alternativa, Bernardo pasó a ser uno de los candidatos a mejorar el juego en esa zona del campo tras la etapa dorada de Kroos y Modric. Es cierto que para Mou era clave su fichaje por su polivalencia, porque puede jugar más arriba, de enganche, o más tirado a una banda, pero al final donde mejor ha encajado es más atrás, incluso dejando a Güler más arriba como se vio en el Camp Nou.

articles.title: Bill Belichick, Jordon Hudson Reportedly 'Secretly' Broke Up Last Year
articles.summary: North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick and his girlfriend, Jordon Hudson, "secretly" broke up last year despite making public appearances since then, according to TMZ Sports.
articles.body:
North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick and his girlfriend, Jordon Hudson, "secretly" broke up last year despite making public appearances since then, according to TMZ Sports .

People's Natasha Dye, Madison E. Goldberg and Zoey Lyttle reported that Belichick and Hudson ended their relationship "late last year," although they have continued to be "committed to their business partnerships and remain close friends."

It's uncertain exactly when their relationship started, but they were first publicly seen together in 2024.

Their relationship faced scrutiny following an April 2025 interview between Belichick and CBS Sunday Morning in which Hudson interrupted multiple times, including after a question was asked about how they met.

That same month, Matt Baker of The Athletic reported that Hudson appeared to have a professional involvement with Belichick despite not having a contract or other employment agreement with North Carolina.

The 25-year-old Hudson also asked Tar Heels staff members to filter negative comments about 74-year-old Belichick on social media, per Dye, Goldberg and Lyttle.

Belichick downplayed Hudson's involvement with North Carolina in an interview with Allie Jones of The Wall Street Journal that was released on Sept. 16.

"The way the story was picked up was a long way from that," Belichick said. "Like, 'She's trying to be the general manager of the team,' and it's so ridiculous."

Hudson has still been spotted at Tar Heels games this season, including a matchup with Notre Dame on Oct. 3.

North Carolina sits at 4-3 under Belichick in 2026 after posting a 4-8 mark during his first year patrolling the sidelines in 2025.

articles.title: Bill Belichick and Jordon Hudson reportedly broke up in secret last year, but still 'committed to their business partnerships'
articles.summary: One of the most scrutinized romances in sports is reportedly over.
articles.body:
North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick and his girlfriend Jordon Hudson broke up in late 2025, according to a report from TMZ . People has also confirmed the report.

The specifics of the breakup are unclear, including who initiated it, but it was apparently amicable enough that TMZ says they are told the pair remain "committed to their business partnerships and remain close friends."

There has been no public indication the much-publicized relationship has ended, as Hudson has remained on the UNC sidelines at games this year. Her most recent Instagram post, dated May 2, features the two holding hands at the Kentucky Derby, with the caption "Not the first time we've trudged through the mud together."

The alleged breakup apparently wasn't well-known, as two people inside the UNC football office told USA Today they weren't aware of it after it was reported.

Belichick, 73, and Hudson first met on a flight in 2021 and went public with their relationship in 2024 while the six-time Super Bowl winner spent the season out of coaching.

By May 2025, The New York Times was reporting that Hudson had told at least one person that she and Belichick were engaged. The relationship reportedly ended months later, though Hudson has continued to work alongside Belichick essentially as his brand manager.

Jordon Hudson was a central figure in Bill Belichick's life, and apparently still is

The initial reactions to Belichick and Hudson's relationship in 2024 ranged from shock to amusement over the nearly five-decade age gap — Hudson was born in 2001, months before Belichick's first Super Bowl-winning season with the New England Patriots.

Hudson's role in Belichick's professional life first received scrutiny in April 2025 when she curtly interrupted a Belichick interview with "CBS Sunday Morning" after the coach was asked about how the two met. Belichick defended Hudson in the aftermath of the interview, and said that she was "simply doing her job to ensure the interview stayed on track."

Belichick was doing the interview to promote his book, however CBS said that no topic was off-limits as part of the discussion.

Not long after the CBS interview was released, North Carolina denied a report from the "Pablo Torre Finds Out" podcast that Hudson had been banned from the North Carolina football facilities. In its statement, UNC said that Hudson was "welcome to the Carolina Football facilities" and that she would "continue to manage all activities related to Coach Belichick's personal brand."

Hudson has been widely reported to have never had an official role at UNC, working instead as a manager for Belichick's own business operations.

That management extended to the now-shelved docu-series that was going to follow North Carolina during its tumultuous 2025 season. The Hulu series was scrapped after North Carolina failed to beat a power conference opponent over the first half of the season. The contracts for the series detailed that Belichick could stop production at any time by retracting his consent to cooperate, and Hudson signed one of them as the COO of TCE Rights Management LLC regarding Belichick's own image rights.

Hudson hasn't received quite as much publicity in 2026, which has been a more successful season for UNC through seven games. The school's record is 4-3, which includes Belichick's first ranked win over No. 25 Pitt .

The Tar Heels play No. 1 Miami on Saturday (7:30 p.m. ET, ABC).

articles.title: New Ohio State Rumors Reveal QB1 Decision for USC Game After Julian Sayin Injury
articles.summary: No. 2 Ohio State has reportedly landed on its replacement for injured quarterback Julian Sayin.
articles.body:
No. 2 Ohio State has reportedly landed on its replacement for injured quarterback Julian Sayin.

The Buckeyes are expected to start true freshman Luke Fahey in Saturday's game at USC, CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz reported Friday.

Ohio State coach Ryan Day declined to confirm this week whether Fahey or sophomore Tavien St. Clair would get the start at USC.

Sayin is expected to miss multiple weeks after suffering a throwing arm injury in an Oct. 17 game against Indiana.

Fahey went 0-for-2 and lost two yards in relief of Sayin at the end of the win over Indiana, since which the Buckeyes have had a bye week.

Day said as of Oct. 20 he felt Fahey had "been ahead of Tavien in terms of what we've seen" but that both quarterbacks would get reps ahead of the USC game.

Although he has declined to commit to one signal caller over the other, Day said earlier this week it was "definitely possible" both would play against USC.

He also expressed hope that whichever quarterback ultimately starts will be aided by star wide receiver Jeremiah Smith, who had previously said he needed more time to develop chemistry with Fahey.

"Jeremiah is a tremendous talent, and he can adjust quickly," Day said Tuesday. "The good thing about he and Luke is, Luke, you've just got to get it somewhere in the neighborhood of No. 4, and he's going to pull it down."

Fahey, a three-star recruit who played high school ball at Mission Viejo, won the backup job earlier this season despite St. Clair's status as a five-star 2025 recruit.

The true freshman has made four appearances this season, going 9-for-13 for 203 yards with two touchdowns and two interceptions in that span.

Day will hope for big games from Smith and the Buckeyes defense when Fahey's first career start kicks off Saturday at 7:30 p.m. ET in Los Angeles.

articles.body: KOLKATA: Mohun Bagan Super Giant will have their task cut out against Punjab FC at the Salt Lake Stadium here on Saturday. articles.body: KOLKATA: Back home after their first away game that brought them their first draw, NorthEast United could not get back to winning ways as a 92nd equaliser from Bengaluru FC youngster Vinith Venkatesh deprived them of a victory through a Jithin MS opener.The Highlanders, however, stayed unbeaten and on top of the table with eight points from four matches while Bengaluru moved up to third spot with seven points from three matches.At the pre-match press conference, Juan Pedro Benali spoke about the team “mentality” being the biggest positive from the matches so far.And that mentality and connection among the NEUFC teammates were in showcase when the Highlanders broke the deadlock in the 15th minute.It started with Gurmeet making a save to a Ryan Murphy corner and led to a counter-attack from the hosts. After the clearance from Jithin fell into the path of Ajaraie, he made a speedy run down the middle and sent a through to Gonzalez who, in turn, sent itto Jithin inside the box. The NEUFC playmaker beat one Bengaluru defender with a dummy and sent a swerving, left-footed shot between the other two and beyond the reach of Gurpreet at the goal.Bengaluru, who maintained almost two-thirds of the possession in the first half, did not get frustrated and continued their well-built attacks inside the NEUFC half. But no penalty was given to the frustration of the Bengaluru players.Barla and Abdul Rabeeh, the two NEUFC fullbacks, kept playing a crucial role for the hosts in curtailing the attacks from the flanks by Aashique Kuruniyan, Ryan Williams and Martinez.NEUFC, continuing with their counter-attacks, had two quick chances to increase the lead through their Moroccan talisman Ajaraie. articles.title: Patrick Stewart's wife wanted Lionel Messi, not Cristiano Ronaldo, and the actor made sure her wish came true
articles.summary: Patrick Stewart had two football icons in front of him at the 2017 Best FIFA Football Awards in London.
articles.body: Patrick Stewart had two football icons in front of him at the 2017 Best FIFA Football Awards in London. Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi were both among the guests, but the actor had a different priority. He wanted to make his wife, Sunny Ozell, happy by introducing her to Messi. The encounter required some effort, as Stewart had to get past security to reach the Argentine. His story has resurfaced following his death at 86, offering a glimpse of the personal side of the actor beyond his celebrated screen roles.Patrick Stewart went out of his way to introduce his wife to Lionel MessiStewart attended the 2017 awards ceremony with Ozell, who had developed a strong admiration for Messi. Her interest in football had grown after watching the Argentine play, and the actor knew that meeting him would mean a great deal to her.He had even promised to make the introduction if Messi attended the event. Stewart recalled the conversation during an interview with the SAG-AFTRA Foundation.“I knew he was going to be at that event, and I told my wife: ‘If he’s there, I’ll do everything in my power to put the two of you face to face.’ She told me, ‘And what happens if he becomes my ‘hall pass’?’ I answered: ‘That’s fine by me,'” Stewart said.Keeping that promise was not easy. The actor recalled seeing Messi, Ronaldo and Argentine legend Diego Maradona at the ceremony, but security made it difficult to approach them.“It was really difficult because there was security as you’ve never seen. Messi was there, Cristiano Ronaldo, and the other great Argentine… Diego Maradona, the Hand of God. I crashed into the security door. ‘Excuse me, excuse me,’ I said. ‘I’m Patrick Stewart,’ I embarrassed myself.”The actor eventually managed to get close to Messi, although finding him in the crowd proved another challenge.Messi's reaction made the meeting even more specialStewart said Messi had turned around and leaned over his seat, making it difficult to spot him among the other guests. When the footballer finally sat up, the two came face to face.“I stood behind him, and he sat up, turned, and we were face to face. And you’ll see, his face… this is very moving for me… It simply lit up before me. And I said to him: ‘Mr. Messi, please, my wife…'” Stewart recalled.Ozell got the photograph she had hoped for. Stewart took a picture of his wife standing beside Messi rather than asking for a selfie. The moment also brought an unexpected gesture from Messi's wife, Antonela Roccuzzo, who asked for a photograph with the actor.“There they shook hands. And I said to them: ‘Please, can I take a photo of you together?’ So I took their photo; it wasn’t a selfie. I took the photo of my wife with Messi, side by side, and then his wife (Antonela Roccuzzo) said: ‘And I want a photo with you!'”Ozell later explained just how much the meeting meant to her. She had met many famous people during her years working in New York restaurants, but Messi was different.“After having worked in fancy New York restaurants for years, I met a lot of important people and became quite immune to nerves. And, to be honest, there aren’t many living human beings in the world I would love to meet. But Messi? Lionel Messi? You can bet your sweet ass I was scared.”Stewart also shared a selfie with Messi on social media, adding a short but memorable caption: “I met a God tonight!”What makes the story stand out is that Stewart was not trying to make his own celebrity encounter the focus. He had made a promise to his wife and wanted to keep it. The fact that Messi's family also joined the moment made the evening even more memorable.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. "Gotta take it one day at a time, that's all I know," he added. "I'm excited about this postseason with these guys here. It's like I told you last year, you never say never. But there's nothing imminent."

On3.com's Chris Low, Brett McMurphy and Pete Nakos reported Friday that Rivers had "emerged as the focus" of the coaching search by NC State, his alma mater.

The eight-time Pro Bowler spent his college career with the Wolfpack from 2000-03, appearing in 49 games for them. He currently serves as head coach of St. Michael Catholic High School in Alabama.

Rivers' son, Gunner, is a quarterback for St. Michael Catholic and has already committed to NC State. Gunner is a 4-star prospect and is listed as the No. 12 player at his position in the 2027 recruiting class, per 247Sports' composite rankings .

The Wolfpack fired Doeren on Saturday after falling to 3-4 to begin the 2026 season. NC State is in danger of compiling its second losing record in three years after previously recording at least eight wins from 2020-23.

articles.title: 'I hope to continue making history in Paris' - Luis Enrique hails 'incredible' PSG squad as Achraf Hakimi scores hat-trick and assists twice in 5-1 Le Havre rout
articles.summary: Paris Saint-Germain head coach Luis Enrique praised the depth and mentality of his side after the reigning French and European champions rallied from a goal...
articles.body:
Paris Saint-Germain head coach Luis Enrique praised the depth and mentality of his side after the reigning French and European champions rallied from a goal down to dismantle bottom club Le Havre on Friday night. Stand-in captain Achraf Hakimi stole the show at the Stade Oceane by directly contributing to all five goals during a dominant display.

Moroccan defender inspires emphatic comeback

Hakimi netted the first treble of his senior career and supplied two assists on Matchday 9 to seal a sixth consecutive Ligue 1 victory for the visitors. With key forwards Ousmane Dembele and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia still sidelined through injury, the Parisians rotated five starters from Monday's 2-0 triumph over Lyon. Despite falling behind early, the leaders recovered to claim a ninth straight win across all competitions.

Winless Le Havre threatened a major upset in the 18th minute when recalled midfielder Senny Mayulu lost possession high up the pitch, allowing Rayan Fofana to break down the right and cross for ex-Sunderland and West Bromwich Albion striker Josh Maja to tap home his fourth goal of the campaign.

After debutant home goalkeeper Arnaud Bodart denied Ferran Torres an equaliser, Hakimi took control despite entering the game without a goal this season. In the 26th minute, the Moroccan brought down Lucas Hernandez's long pass and squared for Belgian winger Mika Godts to slot into the bottom-left corner for his second strike in consecutive outings. Two minutes later, Mayulu released Hakimi to beat Bodart at his near post, with VAR overturning an initial offside flag.

Reflecting on the response after the match, Enrique told PSG TV : "It's a great win. We started the game with the same focus as usual, but we struggled on the counter-attack and that's how they scored their goal. When you play away from home, your opponents are always more motivated. But in the end, we were the ones who dominated the match. We created lots of chances and saw our players perform at a very high level, so we're happy.

"We saw what the Titis are capable of, even if it's difficult to match the standard set by Paris Saint-Germain. But that's what we're aiming for: to be as competitive as possible in every match, whoever the opponent. The win record? I'm lucky enough to manage a club of this level and to have incredible players. I'm very happy and I hope to continue making history in Paris."

Although Sota Nakamura and Fofana threatened to restore parity for a Le Havre side sitting bottom with just two points all season, Hakimi doubled the advantage 10 minutes after the restart. Following Amir Richardson's foul on Maghnes Akliouche on the left edge of the box, the right-back curled a 20-yard free-kick into the bottom-right corner.

A decisive swing occurred in the 62nd minute when Maja headed Djibril Ouziad's right-wing delivery against the outside of the left post. PSG countered immediately as Bodart rushed out of his area and failed to cut out Hakimi's through ball, enabling Mayulu to touch it past the stranded keeper and roll into an empty net from 30 yards. Seven minutes later, Bodart parried Hakimi's initial shot from Godts' low cross straight back onto the defender's right thigh and into the net.

Speaking to PSG TV afterwards, Hakimi said: "It was a very good performance from the whole team, we're very happy. It wasn't easy, we started by conceding a goal, but we showed our spirit and had the right attitude to get back into the game. That's what matters most. It's a great evening for me, especially because we won, but also because it's my first hat-trick. I'm happy and I hope to score as many goals as possible in this shirt."

Having collected just a single point across their opening three Ligue 1 fixtures, PSG have now firmly re-established their authority at the summit of the French top flight . The reigning European champions will look to carry this clinical attacking form into their upcoming Champions League and domestic schedule while awaiting the return of Dembele and Kvaratskhelia. Meanwhile, winless Le Havre remain rooted to the foot of the table.

articles.title: “Wrong Firing,” “Needed a Scapegoat”: NFL Fans Question Dave Canales as Panthers Fire DC Ejiro Evero After Packers Loss

articles.body:
After a 27-19 loss to the Green Bay Packers on Thursday Night Football, the Carolina Panthers have decided to fire defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero, per NFL insider Adam Schefter.

Canales retained Evero as defensive coordinator in 2024 when he took over the head coaching position.

However, the Panthers' defensive struggles have stood out the most as they currently sit on a 3-4 record with a two-game losing streak to conference opponents. The team currently allows 27.6 points per game, making it the sixth-worst defense in the league.

While some fans were relieved after Ejiro's firing, others claimed the team's offensive struggles were the key factor behind the Green Bay loss, as the Panthers could only muster 19 points, including a failed two-point conversion.

"I don't think Evero is the problem out there. But I guess they needed a scapegoat…"

"Wrong firing. Their defense was the only thing that kept them in the game. Offense was atrocious."

Dave Canales Claims Bryce Young's Mobility Affected Offense Against Packers

While Bryce Young threw for 209 yards on 41 passing attempts, including a touchdown and an interception against the Packers, he did not account for any rushing yards while also taking six sacks for 33 yards.

Head coach Dave Canales claimed the quarterback's injuries played a crucial part in the lack of a running game. Canales said in the postgame press conference:

"I would say that, um, that he certainly doesn't look like he's got that, that, you know, quick make-you-miss type of a deal, but he was able to create some space for himself. Um, but the rush got after us, you know, and, and that's the bottom line is we got to take care of that first part of it so we have an element of time to be able to execute the play."
